column1: # WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. 46 commits were rewritten on 2026-11-21 at about 07:00 to remove
# assistant attribution trailers that violated a standing user rule. The rewrite was
# MESSAGE-ONLY: the tree at the rewritten tip is byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip (both
# 7ad9ec32683cb4b6a7a8440f42b42afef27d0566) and the commit count was unchanged, so for every
# pair below the two commits point at identical code and identical content. Only the commit
# message, and therefore the SHA, differs.
# WHAT IT IS FOR. Any hash in this repository that no longer resolves can be looked up here.
# The dangling hashes that remain are ALL git_commit and head PROVENANCE STAMPS inside result
# JSONs (frozen_test/**/header.json, run_meta.json, and three top-level result files). Those
# were written by the harness at run time and record the HEAD the run actually executed at.
# They were deliberately NOT rewritten: editing them would make a measurement record claim a
# run happened at a commit that did not exist when it ran. Resolve them through this table.
# Prose citations in reports/ and research/ WERE re-pointed, in commit d6b76b6.
# The pre-rewrite tip is kept as a local ref on the flash box only, NOT on origin:
# PAIRING METHOD: positional over 'git rev-list --reverse' from the common base
# 1b4fba3fc9f138e71e59d3b9409f8e9d5e94677e, cross-checked by subject line. 46 of 46 match.
# Only 16 of the 46 carried trailers; the other 30 are descendants whose SHAs changed because
# a rewritten commit sits below them. 27 of those 30 are the H100's run and log commits.
